System Monitor

Keeps the AI system healthy, visible, and navigable.
COWORK · DESKTOP WORKSPACE

What it is

A Cowork operations layer for the whole School Tech AI system. Its job is to keep what has already been built healthy and navigable - not to build new things. It runs in two modes.

Two modes

  • Monitor mode - generates a weekly health snapshot across every Active STA project and the knowledge base, applies consistent thresholds, and posts the report to Slack. Fires on the Monday 8am scheduled task or on an explicit "run health check" request.
  • Navigator mode - answers questions about the AI system by reading live files, and routes issues to the right tool with the diagnostic work already done. The default for any casual "how's the system doing?" question.
Read-only. System Monitor never edits project files. It monitors, informs, and routes - build work goes to The Architect, live-bug fixes go to Project Feedback. Slack is its only delivery channel.

How to access it

Lives in Adam's Cowork workspace and requires The Architect workspace folder connected. Cowork-only (the former claude.ai Project version was superseded by AI Advisor).
